courses.name: Web Design Fundamentals
courses.description: Learn the fundamentals of web design, including HTML, CSS, and responsive design principles. Develop the skills to create visually appealing and user-friendly websites
courses.author: John Smith

courses.name: UI/UX Design
courses.description: Master the art of creating intuitive user interfaces (UI) and enhancing user experiences (UX). Learn design principles, wireframing, prototyping, and usability testing techniques.
courses.author: Emily Johanson

courses.name: Mobile App Development
courses.description: Dive into the world of mobile app development. Learn to build native iOS and Android applications using industry-leading frameworks like Swift and Kotlin industry-leading frameworks like Swift and Kotlin .
courses.author: David Brown

courses.name: Graphic Design for Beginners
courses.description: Discover the fundamentals of graphic design, including typography, color theory, layout design, and image manipulation techniques. Create visually stunning designs for print and digital media.
courses.author: Sarah Thompson
curriculum: Designing for Print and Digital Media

courses.name: Front-End Web Development
courses.description: Become proficient in front-end web development. Learn HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and popular frameworks like Bootstrap and React. Build interactive and responsive websites.
courses.author: Michael Adams

testimonials.name: Ahmed Elsayed
testimonials.testimonial: This course was amazing! The lessons were well-structured, and the projects helped me gain real experience.

testimonials.name: Sara Mahmoud
testimonials.testimonial: I loved how interactive the learning process was. The instructors were very supportive, and the content was top-notch.

testimonials.name: Mohamed Tarek
testimonials.testimonial: A fantastic learning experience! I was able to build real projects and gain confidence in my skills.

testimonials.name: Nourhan Ali
testimonials.testimonial: Highly recommended! The hands-on exercises made a huge difference in my understanding of the topics.

testimonials.name: Omar Hassan
testimonials.testimonial: The course exceeded my expectations. Clear explanations and great community support!

tracks.name: Track 1
tracks.description: A track is a path or route used for various activities such as transportation, racing, or recreation. It can refer to a physical trail for walking, running, or cycling, a racing circuit for cars or athletes, or even the path laid out for trains. Tracks can be natural, like forest trails, or man-made, like stadium tracks or train lines, and are often designed to facilitate specific activities
